line_items.reasoning: Q2 revenue of $12.9B came in above the high end of the guided range of $11.2B–$12.4B, exceeding even the most optimistic scenario Intel laid out.

Excluding ~$1B in one-time impairment and period costs, underlying non-GAAP gross margin was ~37.5%, above the guided ~36.5%; reported 29.7% was depressed by non-recurring charges not contemplated in guidance.
Adjusted non-GAAP EPS of ~$0.10 (ex. one-time items) beat the guided breakeven figure, though reported non-GAAP EPS was dragged below zero by the impairment and period costs.
No explicit Q2 CapEx update was flagged as deviating from the lowered 2025 gross CapEx target of ~$18B or net CapEx range of ~$8B–$11B, suggesting execution remains on track with prior guidance.
OpEx trajectory was not called out as deviating from the $17B 2025 target; the Altera/Mobileye capital actions are incremental positives but do not directly contradict the prior OpEx guidance.
